title: Tavern 0.6.209: retain stored items when natural drops fail
public_notes_inline: Natural storage destruction retains native item metadata until all requested drops exist. Failed drops retract confirmed partial drops and restore the original native/public records and a still-empty owner cell. Missing or malformed public state cannot discard adopted native contents. Unconfirmed compensation keeps recovery data without reopening the owner and requires recovery. Creative and doTileDrops=false intentional discard remain unchanged. Source and scoped native evidence are documented; no client, full family or LIVE acceptance is claimed.
